# Trails Offroad

> > Comprehensive offroad trail database with GPS maps, difficulty ratings, and user reviews for 4WD, ATV, and OHV routes across the United States and Canada.

Trails Offroad provides detailed trail guides covering national forests, BLM land, ORV parks, and wilderness areas. The site features Motor Vehicle Use Maps (MVUM), dispersed camping information, and trail difficulty ratings for offroad enthusiasts planning adventures on public lands managed by USFS and Bureau of Land Management.

## Key Topics

- Offroad trail guides and GPS maps
- Difficulty ratings and trail reviews
- Scout routes and 4WD trails
- Dispersed camping locations
- Motor Vehicle Use Maps (MVUM)
- USFS and BLM public lands
- National Forest offroading
- ORV parks and OHV recreation areas
- Arizona trail systems (Sedona, Coconino County, Sitgreaves National Forest)
- Rock crawling and technical routes
- State-by-state trail directories
- Beginner and intermediate trail recommendations
- Trail conditions and seasonal access
- Wilderness access roads
- Canadian backcountry routes

## State & Regional Trail Directories

- [Offroad Trails in Alaska](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/alaska): Alaska offroad trail directory with maps, reviews & difficulty ratings
- [Offroad Trails in Arizona](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/arizona): Arizona offroad trail directory with scout routes, 4WD trails, and MVUM information
- [Offroad Trails in Minnesota](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/minnesota): Minnesota offroad trail directory with maps, reviews & difficulty ratings
- [Offroad Trails in Pennsylvania](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/pennsylvania): Pennsylvania offroad trail directory with maps, reviews & ORV park info
- [Offroad Trails in Hawaii](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/hawaii): Hawaii offroad trail directory with maps, reviews & difficulty ratings
- [Offroad Trails in Sand Hollow](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/utah/regions/sand-hollow): Sand Hollow trail directory with rock crawling & sand dune routes, Utah

## Arizona Scout Routes & 4WD Trails

- [Heber Mormon Crossing, Arizona](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/arizona/scout-routes/729-heber-mormon-crossing): 25-mile scout route from Heber-Overgaard to Hwy 99 through Sitgreaves NF
- [Buffalo Ranch Road, Arizona](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/arizona/scout-routes/751-buffalo-ranch-road): 4WD access road to Grand Canyon North Rim through sandy terrain
- [Charco Four, Arizona](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/arizona/scout-routes/381-charco-four): Gateway route into Kofa National Wildlife Refuge from I-10, La Paz County
- [Pyeatt Draw Road, Arizona](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/arizona/scout-routes/721-pyeatt-draw-road): Connector route to Pyeatt Draw rock crawling trails in Gila County, AZ
- [North Boundary, Arizona](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/arizona/scout-routes/740-north-boundary): Northern Sitgreaves NF boundary connector through juniper grasslands
- [Bull Pen, Arizona](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/arizona/scout-routes/715-bull-pen): Day-use trail to West Clear Creek riparian area near Camp Verde, AZ
- [Milligan Valley, Arizona](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/arizona/scout-routes/1213-milligan-valley): Seasonal scenic route through prairies & pine forests, Apache County, AZ

## Alaska & Canadian Wilderness Routes

- [McCarthy Road, Alaska](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/alaska/scout-routes/5222-mccarthy-road): 60-mile wilderness route to McCarthy & Kennecott Mine in Wrangell-St. Elias
- [Canoe East Forest Service Road, British Columbia](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/CAN/british-columbia/scout-routes/2849-canoe-east-forest-service-road): FSR from Valemount along Kimbasket Lake with glacier views & camping

## ORV Parks & Recreation Areas

- [Offroad Trails in Anthracite Outdoor Adventure Area (AOAA)](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/US/pennsylvania/orv-parks/anthracite-outdoor-adventure-area): AOAA ORV park trail directory near Shamokin, PA with ATV/UTV routes

## Trail Guides & Recommendations

- [Best Intermediate Off-Roading Trails in Colorado](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/blog/best-intermediate-off-roading-trails-in-colorado): Top 13 intermediate Colorado trails including Bill Moore Lake & alpine routes
- [Top 5 Beginner Trails in Big Bear CA](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/blog/top-5-beginner-trails-in-big-bear-ca): Best beginner-friendly offroad trails in Big Bear, Southern California
- [Offroading the Daniel Boone Backcountry Byway and Red River Gorge](https://www.trailsoffroad.com/blog/daniel-boone-backcountry-byway-offroad-trails): Guide to offroading Daniel Boone Backcountry Byway & Red River Gorge, KY
